behaviors.description: Run an app that consumes piped stdin, echoes it, and changes and restores terminal settings.
behaviors.preconditions: Fresh user installation of the fixture app and a foreground pipeline in an interactive pseudo-terminal shell.
behaviors.expected: The app echoes the exact piped marker, applies and restores terminal settings, and exits zero without job-control suspension.

mappings.rationale: An installed fixture app consumes a real pipe, echoes the exact marker, and exercises terminal-setting operations that can suspend a process even when ordinary terminal writes succeed.
